title: The blank gallons row
overall: One continuous, conversational read. Open with a real form, lift only for the announcement and field mechanism, then drop for the missing direct report. End lower than the middle. The film illustrates reporting fields, not observed site water flow. Keep ordinary breaths, read only the locked script, and let the editor place the longer pauses.
editor_note: One continuous take. No time stretching. A measured silence-only trim may preserve speech and move the final cut to its proven duration.

pronunciation.TWDB: T W D B, separate letters

lines.text: This form asks for gallons. What if no response arrives?
lines.intent: The actual blank template poses the reporting question. Close, curious, never accusatory.
lines.risk: Do not imply that the blank template is an actual unreturned form.

lines.text: Paxton says he is investigating hundreds of data-center developments over missing surveys.
lines.intent: Attribute the count to Paxton while the dated public announcement enters.
lines.risk: Paxton says must remain audible; hundreds is his reported count, not an independently verified roster.

lines.text: The form separates groundwater, surface water, purchased water, and reuse.
lines.intent: Name four form categories as separate possibilities; no site flow is observed.
lines.risk: These are possible survey categories, not simultaneous intake paths at one data center.

lines.text: Groundwater, surface and purchased water require monthly gallons and a metered-or-estimated flag.
lines.intent: Carry the mechanism from monthly gallons to the separate metered-or-estimated field.
lines.risk: The metered-or-estimated choice is a separate per-source field, not a flag on each monthly row.

lines.text: The returns guide planning. Without one, planners lack that facility’s direct report.
lines.intent: Let the absent direct return land quietly as the planning tile drops.
lines.risk: A missing direct report does not mean planners have no estimate from other records.

lines.text: The announcement names counties, but no company, site volume, or completed penalty.
lines.intent: State exactly what the announcement omits without implying a penalty has occurred.
lines.risk: The announcement supplies no named site volume or completed penalty; do not expand this to all records.

lines.text: The online survey closed. TWDB still accepts late PDF forms.
lines.intent: Open the late PDF route as an available next action, not a filing shown on screen.
lines.risk: Speak T W D B and P D F as letters. The online survey closed; late PDFs remain accepted.

lines.text: By October 14th, TWDB must update the Governor on enforcement progress. The announcement gives no site volume.
lines.intent: Name the Governor update date and settle on the absent site volume in this announcement.
lines.risk: Speak T W D B as letters and October fourteenth naturally. The update is to the Governor, not a filing deadline.
